effect: The marked selector completed the shared local controls, and Sal and Miro both successfully used their fobs. The chapter goal is complete.
reaction: It was satisfying to see control shared rather than left with June alone.

mostWorthwhile.text: Matching the notice to the rack was most worthwhile: it distinguished the modem's approval signal from its uplink and showed exactly what could be isolated.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the selector twice before its prerequisites were ready, followed by an inspection with no partners, was frustrating and slowed progress.

surprise.text: The fobs paired with the selector rather than directly with the rack; recognizing a fob still did not operate the switch.

arbitrary.text: The required ordering around the selector was not clear initially. The labels had a clear accessibility purpose, but I did not anticipate that they were needed before fitting it.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the shared controls hold up beyond the workshop; the specific ownership and permission distinctions made this chapter interesting despite the opaque prerequisites.
